name: underleveledbuilder/short-drama-skill-finder
description: A router skill for a large curated list of short drama skills, tools, and platforms. It finds a short drama skill by language, featured status, checked status, stars, and publication fields, then installs it with the npx skills add owner/repo pattern. Tailored for Chinese language workflows.
install: npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-short-drama-skills to install the short-drama-skill-finder router, then ask the agent for a short drama skill
